basics.name: Novi Irnawati
basics.summary:
A results-driven technology professional with a progressive career in digital banking, spanning Project Administration, Backend Development, Technical Leadership, and Solution Architecture within large-scale, regulated financial institutions serving millions of users across Indonesia.

A generalist in IT, combining deep domain expertise in digital banking systems with broad hands-on experience across the full software development lifecycle, from writing and reviewing code to architecting systems, leading squads, managing procurement, and collaborating with stakeholders across all levels of the organization.

While rooted in software engineering and solution architecture, my cross-functional experience across the full software development lifecycle makes me adaptable to a range of roles in the technology and banking industry, including:
  • Software Engineering - Backend, Full Stack, Technical Writer
  • Technical Leadership - Tech Lead, Solution Architect
  • Quality & Testing - Software Tester, QA Engineer
  • Delivery & Agile - Project Manager, Scrum Master, IT Project Admin
  • Analysis & Design - System Analyst, Business Analyst
  • Product - Product Owner
  • Data & Integration - Data Engineer, ETL Developer
  • Risk & Compliance - Fraud Analyst, IT Security Analyst

Currently open to remote roles and collaborations worldwide.

work.name: Private Owned Bank

Drove application performance improvements by initiating and managing Change Requests, identifying bottlenecks across Reverse Proxy, and API Gateway layers, and proposing architectural solutions to reduce incidents and improve system reliability at scale for millions of active user base.

Managed and troubleshot distributed systems components including In-Memory Data Cache, Event Streaming and Message Queues, and CI/CD Pipelines, ensuring reliability and performance at high transaction volumes.

Maintained observability using Application Performance Monitoring (APM), Infrastructure Monitoring, and Log Management tools, ensuring SLA compliance and uptime targets for a high-traffic production banking platform processing hundreds of thousands of daily transactions.

Collaborated cross-functionally with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Tech Leads, and fellow Solution Architects to deliver end-to-end feature roadmaps, maintaining Technical Documentation standards throughout the software development lifecycle.

publications.name: International Review on Computers and Software (IRECOS) Vol 15, No 2 (2020). Android Based Application Using Google Maps API for Tourism Travel Guide.
publications.summary: This research aims to design, build, and implement an application that able to increase knowledge and interest of society to tourism of Jakarta by providing various information about tourist location in DKI Jakarta as well as giving guide of travel route to tourist location, as guide in doing tourism activity to location – location of tourism in DKI Jakarta. This application development method uses waterfall system development methodology that has 5 phases of communication, planning, modeling, construction, and deployment. This application is built using Android Studio IDE, Java programming language, SQLite as database, and utilize Google Maps API to display the map. With this application, people who want to find information about Jakarta tourism can obtain various tourist information and guide the route to tourist locations in Jakarta more quickly and easily.
